Why organisations choose Kraal Code

Kraal Code was not adapted from a system built for another market. It was designed from the ground up for how East and Central African organisations actually operate.

Affordable without being limited

From UGX 250,000 per month for your whole organisation — not per user. No implementation fees. No USD exchange rate surprises. Annual billing gives you 12 months for the price of 10.

For a 30-user organisation, Kraal Code Professional costs UGX 1,000,000/month. The same size on Odoo Enterprise would cost approximately UGX 4,300,000/month — before implementation costs.

Usable from day one

The Golden Rule: any employee should be able to complete core tasks on their first day without training. This is enforced by an 85% unassisted task success rate target across five benchmark tasks.

Most ERP systems require weeks of training before anyone can use them productively. Kraal Code is designed so that the interface teaches itself.

Africa-native integrations

MTN MoMo, Airtel Money, M-Pesa, and EFRIS integrations are platform services — not afterthought add-ons. Mobile money salary disbursement, supplier payments, and customer receipts are built in.

Localisation is configuration, not code. Adding a new country requires only a localisation profile with the right statutory rules, currency, and tax settings.

Serious about security

Tenant isolation, role-based access, immutable audit trails, AES-256 encryption, MFA, and OWASP Top 10 mapping. Security is not a footer badge — it is an architecture.

Remote work, branch operations, and cloud access are only possible when you can trust the system to maintain accountability.

Modular growth

Start with six core modules. Add manufacturing, HR, projects, or AI intelligence when your organisation is ready. Every module shares the same data model and permission system.

You do not need to replace your systems as you grow — Kraal Code grows with you.

Regional understanding

Built by a team that understands local business practices, regulatory requirements, and operating constraints. Multi-country statutory compliance for Uganda, Kenya, Tanzania, and Rwanda from launch.

Support and implementation grounded in the region — not a help desk in another timezone.

See for yourself

The best way to understand Kraal Code is to see it running with your data, your workflows, and your team.
